title: Implement the original-DINO training step
prompt: Run one small original-DINO step with supplied BN-free, dropout-free matching networks returning [B,K]. If teacher is None, deepcopy/freeze the student. The first two aligned views are global; the student sees all views. Optimize student, EMA-update teacher using the NEW student, update center from OLD raw teacher logits, and return (loss,teacher,new_center). This is the training core, not DINOv3 pretraining; caller owns augmentation and checkpoints.
